test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 8 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some mats are figs.

All figs are clips.

No clip is a stand.

**Conclusions:**

I. All mats being stands is a possibility.

II. Some clips are mats.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow
Neither conclusion I nor II follows

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram of given statement is :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d21c5f90bd5eeec354dc338abe320a94aa4807d1f9d16b1e3b2efc6f64a7cdfb.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All mats being stands is a possibility. → Does not follow ( because a part of mats is common to figs that are clips and no clip is a stand.)

II. Some clips are mats.→ Follows ( as shown above in the Venn diagram)

Hence, the correct answer is "Only conclusion II follows"

Hence, the **correct answer** is **"Option 3"**
